description: Defines a template class 'NoDestructor' that provides a way to create static objects with static storage duration that are only constructed on first access and never invoke their destructor, used to avoid static initialization order issues and destructor calls.

classes.name: NoDestructor
classes.description: A template class that manages object lifetime by constructing an object of type T on first access and never invoking its destructor, ensuring thread-safe lazy initialization without destructor calls.

methods.name: NoDestructor
methods.description: Constructor template that constructs an object of type T in-place with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: NoDestructor(const T &x)
methods.description: Copy constructor that constructs the object in-place from a const reference.

methods.name: NoDestructor(T &&x)
methods.description: Move constructor that constructs the object in-place from an rvalue reference.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator returning a reference to the stored object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Arrow operator returning a pointer to the stored object.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the stored object.
